title: Which function gets called?

prereqs.why: Every line of the output is one name-lookup decision, which is what a namespace changes.

statement:
Three functions called `value`, in three different places. The program prints which one each call reached.

**What does it print?** Four lines.
hints: `::value()` with nothing in front of the `::` means the *global* namespace, explicitly. That is different from writing `value()` with nothing at all.
Inside a namespace, an unqualified name is looked for in that namespace first, and only then outside it.
The last call is made from inside `inner`, which is nested in `outer`. Work outwards from there.
